ImageDescription.value: SANTA RITA, Guam (MAR. 5, 2012) Carman Osbahr-Vertiz as Rosita, left, and Kevin Clash as Elmo, perform with a student from Cmdr. William C. McCool Elementary/Middle School on U.S. Naval Base Guam March 5. Elmo and Rosita visited the school as part of Talk, Listen, Connect, a multiphase educational outreach initiative designed to help kids through deployments, homecomings, combat-related injuries and the death of a parent or loved one serving in the military. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Corey Hensley/Released)
